final_lessons: Lower learning rate (0.0003) with Adam and shallow wide architecture (d_model=128, 1 layer) outperformed deeper or higher-lr configurations on limited budget.
SGD with momentum=0.9 can outperform Adam variants on simple bigram tasks even with lower learning rates.
Reuse candidates with proven low CE from prior questions when they reappear identically.
SGD momentum with higher learning rate 0.01 and plain cross_entropy consistently performs well on bigram tasks.
Adam lr=0.0003 with d_model=128 single-layer architecture reliably yields low CE across questions.
SGD momentum lr=0.01 with d_model=128 2-layer (c_625516) is a strong proven performer.
The proven winner c_ceb7bb (Adam lr=0.0003, d_model=128, 1 layer) remains a strong choice when present.
c_918460 (Adam lr=0.0003, d_model=128, 1 layer) is the lowest-CE known candidate.
When top candidates c_918460/c_ceb7bb are absent, fall back to the next-best proven performer like c_532a47.
